newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli forces kills two Lebanon guerrillas.
newsitem.headline: Israeli forces kills two Lebanon guerrillas.

text.p: Israeli forces killed two Arab guerrillas in a clash in south Lebanon on Saturday, pro-Israeli militia sources said.

An Israeli force fired at the guerrillas in Jabal al-Rafii, a rugged mountain area controlled by the pro-Iranian Hizbollah on the edge of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, the South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia sources said.
It was not immediately known if the two guerrillas killed belonged to Hizbollah (Party of God) or another faction.

Hizbollah leads a guerrilla war against some 1,000 Israeli troops and the 3,000-strong SLA militia holding the 15-km (nine-mile) -deep zone in south Lebanon which was set up to stop cross-frontier guerrilla raids on northern Israel.
